name: Sức khoẻ
description: Triệu chứng, bệnh thường gặp, thuốc, khám chữa bệnh, cơ thể và lối sống lành mạnh: những từ chưa có trong bộ 3000 từ. Nội dung do AI soạn. Giấy phép CC BY-SA 4.0.

words.explanationEn: a painful feeling at the back of your mouth when you swallow
words.example: I have a sore throat and a cough.
words.exampleVi: Tôi bị đau họng và ho.

words.explanationEn: when liquid keeps dripping from your nostrils, often because of a cold
words.example: The baby has a runny nose.
words.exampleVi: Em bé bị sổ mũi.

words.explanationEn: to blow air out of your nose and mouth suddenly, without meaning to
words.example: Dust always makes me sneeze.
words.exampleVi: Bụi lúc nào cũng làm tôi hắt hơi.

words.explanationEn: a pain in your belly
words.example: He ate too much and got a stomachache.
words.exampleVi: Anh ấy ăn quá nhiều nên bị đau bụng.

words.explanationEn: a pain in one of your teeth
words.example: I couldn't sleep because of a toothache.
words.exampleVi: Tôi không ngủ được vì đau răng.

words.explanationEn: a pain that goes on for a long time but is not sharp
words.example: I have an ache in my lower back.
words.exampleVi: Tôi bị đau âm ỉ ở thắt lưng.

words.explanationEn: painful, especially when touched or used
words.example: My legs are sore after the long walk.
words.exampleVi: Chân tôi nhức sau chuyến đi bộ dài.

words.explanationEn: feeling as if everything is spinning and you might fall
words.example: I feel dizzy when I stand up too fast.
words.exampleVi: Tôi thấy chóng mặt khi đứng dậy quá nhanh.

words.explanationEn: the feeling that you are going to be sick and throw up
words.example: This medicine can cause nausea.
words.exampleVi: Thuốc này có thể gây buồn nôn.

words.explanationEn: to bring food up from your stomach through your mouth
words.example: The child vomited twice in the car.
words.exampleVi: Đứa bé nôn hai lần trên xe.

words.explanationEn: an illness in which waste from your body is watery and comes often
words.example: Drink plenty of water if you have diarrhea.
words.exampleVi: Uống nhiều nước nếu bạn bị tiêu chảy.

words.explanationEn: an area of small red spots on the skin
words.example: She has a rash on her arm.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy bị phát ban ở tay.

words.explanationEn: making you want to scratch your skin
words.example: Mosquito bites are very itchy.
words.exampleVi: Vết muỗi đốt rất ngứa.

words.explanationEn: bigger than usual because of an injury or illness
words.example: His ankle is badly swollen.
words.exampleVi: Mắt cá chân của anh ấy sưng to.

words.explanationEn: a dark mark on the skin where you were hit
words.example: She had bruises on both knees.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy bị bầm tím ở cả hai đầu gối.

words.explanationEn: a small bubble on the skin filled with liquid, often caused by rubbing
words.example: My new shoes gave me a blister.
words.exampleVi: Đôi giày mới làm chân tôi phồng rộp.

words.explanationEn: to hurt a joint, such as your ankle, by twisting it
words.example: He sprained his wrist playing football.
words.exampleVi: Anh ấy bị bong gân cổ tay khi chơi bóng đá.

words.explanationEn: a crack or break in a bone
words.example: The X-ray showed a small fracture.
words.exampleVi: Phim chụp cho thấy một chỗ rạn xương nhỏ.

words.explanationEn: a sudden, painful tightening of a muscle
words.example: I got a cramp in my leg while swimming.
words.exampleVi: Tôi bị chuột rút ở chân khi đang bơi.

words.explanationEn: to suddenly fall down and lose consciousness for a short time
words.example: She fainted in the hot sun.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy ngất dưới trời nắng nóng.

words.explanationEn: a bad reaction of your body to certain foods, plants or animals
words.example: Do you have any food allergies?
words.exampleVi: Bạn có bị dị ứng thức ăn nào không?

words.explanationEn: having a bad reaction to something you eat, touch or breathe in
words.example: I'm allergic to cats.
words.exampleVi: Tôi bị dị ứng với mèo.

words.explanationEn: an illness that sometimes makes breathing difficult
words.example: My brother has had asthma since he was a child.
words.exampleVi: Em trai tôi bị hen từ nhỏ.

words.explanationEn: a disease in which there is too much sugar in the blood
words.example: People with diabetes must watch what they eat.
words.exampleVi: Người bị tiểu đường phải chú ý ăn uống.

words.explanationEn: a very bad headache, often with feeling sick
words.example: Bright light gives her migraines.
words.exampleVi: Ánh sáng chói làm cô ấy bị đau nửa đầu.

words.explanationEn: red, painful skin caused by too much time in strong sunlight
words.example: I got a bad sunburn at the beach.
words.exampleVi: Tôi bị cháy nắng nặng ở bãi biển.

words.explanationEn: an illness of the stomach caused by eating something bad or dirty
words.example: Half the group got food poisoning.
words.exampleVi: Một nửa đoàn bị ngộ độc thực phẩm.

words.explanationEn: an allergy to pollen that makes you sneeze
words.meaningVi: viêm mũi dị ứng phấn hoa
words.example: My hay fever is bad every spring.
words.exampleVi: Mùa xuân nào tôi cũng bị viêm mũi dị ứng nặng.

words.explanationEn: a sudden serious illness when the organ that pumps blood stops working properly
words.meaningVi: cơn đau tim, nhồi máu cơ tim
words.example: He had a heart attack last year.
words.exampleVi: Ông ấy bị nhồi máu cơ tim năm ngoái.

words.explanationEn: a serious infection of the lungs
words.example: Grandpa was in hospital with pneumonia.
words.exampleVi: Ông phải nằm viện vì viêm phổi.

words.explanationEn: being unable to sleep well over a long period
words.example: Coffee at night can cause insomnia.
words.exampleVi: Uống cà phê buổi tối có thể gây mất ngủ.

words.explanationEn: great tiredness
words.example: Fatigue is a common sign of illness.
words.exampleVi: Mệt mỏi là dấu hiệu thường gặp khi bị bệnh.

words.explanationEn: a condition when your body does not have enough water
words.example: Drink more water to avoid dehydration.
words.exampleVi: Uống thêm nước để tránh mất nước.

words.explanationEn: a place where people go to see a doctor, smaller than a hospital
words.example: The clinic opens at eight.
words.exampleVi: Phòng khám mở cửa lúc tám giờ.

words.explanationEn: a vehicle that takes sick or injured people to hospital
words.example: Call an ambulance, quickly!
words.exampleVi: Gọi xe cấp cứu, nhanh lên!

words.explanationEn: simple help given to an injured person before a doctor arrives
words.example: Every teacher should learn first aid.
words.exampleVi: Giáo viên nào cũng nên học sơ cứu.

words.explanationEn: a long strip of cloth wrapped around a wound
words.example: The nurse put a bandage on my arm.
words.exampleVi: Y tá băng tay cho tôi.

words.explanationEn: a small sticky strip you put over a small cut
words.example: Put a plaster on your finger.
words.exampleVi: Dán băng cá nhân vào ngón tay đi.

words.explanationEn: a short piece of thread a doctor uses to close a cut in the skin
words.example: He needed five stitches in his head.
words.exampleVi: Anh ấy phải khâu năm mũi ở đầu.

words.explanationEn: a person whose job is to prepare and sell medicines
words.example: Ask the pharmacist which medicine to take.
words.exampleVi: Hỏi dược sĩ nên uống thuốc nào.

words.explanationEn: a written order from a doctor for medicine
words.example: You need a prescription for this medicine.
words.exampleVi: Bạn cần có đơn thuốc để mua loại thuốc này.

words.explanationEn: a small round piece of medicine that you swallow
words.example: Take two pills after each meal.
words.exampleVi: Uống hai viên sau mỗi bữa ăn.

words.explanationEn: a small hard piece of medicine
words.example: Dissolve the tablet in a glass of water.
words.exampleVi: Hoà tan viên thuốc vào một cốc nước.

words.explanationEn: medicine in a small soft shell that you swallow whole
words.example: Take one capsule every morning.
words.exampleVi: Uống một viên con nhộng mỗi sáng.

words.explanationEn: a thick sweet liquid medicine, often for coughs
words.example: Give the child a spoon of cough syrup.
words.exampleVi: Cho bé uống một thìa siro ho.

words.explanationEn: a smooth cream you rub on the skin to make it better
words.example: Put this ointment on the burn.
words.exampleVi: Bôi thuốc mỡ này lên vết bỏng.

words.explanationEn: a medicine that makes an ache or hurt go away
words.example: I took a painkiller for my headache.
words.exampleVi: Tôi uống một viên giảm đau vì nhức đầu.

words.explanationEn: a medicine that kills bacteria and cures infections
words.example: Finish all the antibiotics, even if you feel better.
words.exampleVi: Uống hết kháng sinh, kể cả khi bạn thấy đỡ hơn.

words.explanationEn: the amount of medicine you take at one time
words.example: Don't take more than the normal dose.
words.exampleVi: Đừng uống quá liều bình thường.

words.explanationEn: an unwanted result of taking a medicine
words.example: Sleepiness is a side effect of this pill.
words.exampleVi: Buồn ngủ là tác dụng phụ của viên thuốc này.

words.explanationEn: a substance put into the body to protect it from a disease
words.example: Children get the measles vaccine at nine months.
words.exampleVi: Trẻ được tiêm vắc-xin sởi lúc chín tháng tuổi.

words.explanationEn: putting medicine into the body with a needle
words.example: The nurse gave me an injection.
words.exampleVi: Y tá tiêm cho tôi một mũi.

words.explanationEn: a device that measures how hot your body is
words.example: Put the thermometer under your arm.
words.exampleVi: Kẹp nhiệt kế dưới nách.

words.explanationEn: a photo of the inside of your body, used to see bones
words.example: The doctor sent me for an x-ray.
words.exampleVi: Bác sĩ cho tôi đi chụp X-quang.

words.explanationEn: a doctor who does operations
words.example: The surgeon said the operation went well.
words.exampleVi: Bác sĩ phẫu thuật nói ca mổ diễn ra tốt.

words.explanationEn: finding out what illness a person has
words.example: We are waiting for the doctor's diagnosis.
words.exampleVi: Chúng tôi đang chờ bác sĩ chẩn đoán.

words.explanationEn: a general medical examination to see if you are well
words.meaningVi: lần khám sức khoẻ định kỳ
words.example: I go for a checkup once a year.
words.exampleVi: Tôi đi khám sức khoẻ mỗi năm một lần.

words.explanationEn: to become well again after an injury
words.example: The cut healed in a week.
words.exampleVi: Vết đứt lành trong một tuần.

words.explanationEn: the force of the red liquid that your heart pumps around your body, measured by a doctor
words.example: The nurse checked my blood pressure.
words.exampleVi: Y tá đo huyết áp cho tôi.

words.explanationEn: the regular beat of your heart that you can feel at your wrist
words.example: The doctor took my pulse.
words.exampleVi: Bác sĩ bắt mạch cho tôi.

words.explanationEn: the sound or movement of the organ that pumps blood
words.example: I could hear the baby's heartbeat.
words.exampleVi: Tôi nghe được nhịp tim của em bé.

words.explanationEn: the parts of the body that fight infections
words.example: Sleep helps your immune system.
words.exampleVi: Ngủ đủ giúp hệ miễn dịch khoẻ.

words.explanationEn: one of the two organs in your chest that you breathe with
words.example: Smoking damages your lungs.
words.exampleVi: Hút thuốc làm hại phổi.

words.explanationEn: one of two organs in your body that clean the blood and make urine
words.example: Drinking water is good for your kidneys.
words.exampleVi: Uống nước tốt cho thận.

words.explanationEn: the line of bones down the middle of your back
words.example: Sit up straight to protect your spine.
words.exampleVi: Ngồi thẳng lưng để bảo vệ cột sống.

words.explanationEn: the joint between your foot and your leg
words.example: She twisted her ankle on the stairs.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy bị trẹo mắt cá chân trên cầu thang.

words.explanationEn: the part of your body at each side where your leg joins it
words.example: Grandma broke her hip last winter.
words.exampleVi: Bà bị gãy xương hông mùa đông năm ngoái.

words.explanationEn: the pink flesh in your mouth that holds your teeth
words.example: My gums bleed when I brush my teeth.
words.exampleVi: Lợi tôi chảy máu khi đánh răng.

words.explanationEn: how well you can see
words.example: His eyesight is getting worse.
words.exampleVi: Thị lực của ông ấy ngày càng kém.

words.explanationEn: a hole in a tooth
words.example: The dentist found two cavities.
words.exampleVi: Nha sĩ phát hiện hai lỗ sâu răng.

words.explanationEn: a person who tests your vision and sells glasses
words.meaningVi: chuyên viên đo mắt, người bán kính
words.example: The optician said I need new glasses.
words.exampleVi: Người đo mắt nói tôi cần kính mới.

words.explanationEn: a small electronic device worn in the ear that makes sounds louder
words.example: My grandfather wears a hearing aid.
words.exampleVi: Ông tôi đeo máy trợ thính.

words.explanationEn: a seat that rolls, for people who cannot walk
words.example: The hotel has rooms for wheelchair users.
words.exampleVi: Khách sạn có phòng cho người dùng xe lăn.

words.explanationEn: a stick that fits under your arm to help you walk after an injury
words.example: He walked on crutches for a month.
words.exampleVi: Anh ấy đi nạng suốt một tháng.

words.explanationEn: time off work because you are ill
words.example: She is on sick leave this week.
words.exampleVi: Tuần này cô ấy nghỉ ốm.

words.explanationEn: keeping yourself and your home clean to stay healthy
words.example: Good hygiene stops diseases from spreading.
words.exampleVi: Giữ vệ sinh tốt ngăn bệnh lây lan.

words.explanationEn: a liquid or gel that kills germs on your hands
words.example: There is hand sanitizer at the door.
words.exampleVi: Có nước rửa tay khô ở cửa.

words.explanationEn: a natural substance in food that your body needs to stay healthy
words.example: Oranges are full of vitamin C.
words.exampleVi: Cam có nhiều vitamin C.

words.explanationEn: the food you eat and how it helps your body
words.example: Good nutrition is important for children.
words.exampleVi: Dinh dưỡng tốt rất quan trọng với trẻ em.

words.explanationEn: a unit for measuring how much energy food gives you
words.example: This drink has a lot of calories.
words.exampleVi: Đồ uống này có nhiều calo.

words.explanationEn: a fatty substance in the blood; too much can harm your heart
words.example: Fried food can raise your cholesterol.
words.exampleVi: Đồ chiên có thể làm tăng mỡ máu.

words.explanationEn: heavier than is healthy
words.example: The doctor said I was a little overweight.
words.exampleVi: Bác sĩ nói tôi hơi thừa cân.

words.explanationEn: a period of physical exercise
words.example: I do a short workout every morning.
words.exampleVi: Tôi tập thể dục một chút mỗi sáng.

words.explanationEn: being healthy and strong, especially through exercise
words.example: Swimming is good for your fitness.
words.exampleVi: Bơi lội tốt cho thể lực.

words.explanationEn: exercises for the body and mind, with slow breathing and stretching
words.example: My mother does yoga three times a week.
words.exampleVi: Mẹ tôi tập yoga ba lần một tuần.

words.explanationEn: running slowly for exercise
words.example: We go jogging in the park every evening.
words.exampleVi: Chúng tôi chạy bộ trong công viên mỗi tối.
